description: A Kotlin source file defining the HomeFragment class for an Android TV app. The fragment manages the home screen UI, including a hero banner carousel, 'Seguí viendo' (Continue Watching) rail, and 'Canales de TV' (TV Channels) rail. It incorporates focus management, D-pad navigation, auto-scrolling of hero cards, and integrates with a ViewModel for data fetching.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: Main fragment for the Android TV home screen. Manages hero carousel, content rails, focus navigation, auto-scroll, and data binding with ViewModel.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes repository and ViewModel.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Constructs and configures the UI hierarchy, including compose top nav, hero banner, and content rails.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets initial focus and observes LiveData for UI updates.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Resume auto-scroll and focus management.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Pause auto-scroll when paused.

methods.name: observeViewModelStates
methods.description: Maps LiveData states to UI updates, including loading, success, and error handling.

methods.name: showContinueWatchingLoading
methods.description: Show loading indicator for Continue Watching.

methods.name: hideContinueWatchingLoading
methods.description: Hide loading indicator for Continue Watching.

methods.name: showTvChannelsLoading
methods.description: Show loading indicator for TV Channels section.

methods.name: hideTvChannelsLoading
methods.description: Hide loading indicator for TV Channels section.

methods.name: showErrorWithRetry
methods.description: Display error message with retry option via Toast.

methods.name: updateContinueWatchingRail
methods.description: Populate Continue Watching section with data.

methods.name: updateTvChannelsRail
methods.description: Populate TV Channels section with data.

methods.name: addComposeTopNavBar
methods.description: Inserts a Compose-based top navigation bar with initial focus on search icon.

methods.name: setupHeroBanner
methods.description: Configures hero carousel with auto-scroll, focus, and peeking cards.

methods.name: centerHeroAt
methods.description: Scrolls hero carousel to center a specific card, with peeking.

methods.name: pauseAutoScrollForUserInteraction
methods.description: Pauses hero auto-scrolling during user interaction.

methods.name: startHeroAutoScroll
methods.description: Begins periodic auto-scroll of hero carousel.

methods.name: stopHeroAutoScroll
methods.description: Stops the auto-scroll handler.

methods.name: setupContinueWatchingSection
methods.description: Builds the 'Seguí viendo' horizontal content rail.

methods.name: setupTvChannelsSection
methods.description: Builds the 'Canales de TV' horizontal content rail.

methods.name: setRailsFocusable
methods.description: Enables or disables focusability of the content rails as a focus gate.

methods.name: dpToPx
methods.description: Converts dp units to pixels based on device density.
